analysis.one_line_summary: Receipt-themed Black Friday promo graphic for the pink WavyTalk Turblow Pro hair dryer at $80.10 (33% off).
analysis.full_description: A square graphic designed in a wrinkled paper shopping receipt aesthetic against a dark textured burgundy backdrop. The receipt features the WavyTalk logo, 'Black Friday', and a price discount of '$80.10 | 33% OFF'. Below, an itemized line item reads 'TURBLOW PRO / Fast Drying Hair Dryer / QTY 1' accompanied by a product render of the metallic pink Turblow Pro hair dryer. A circular dark purple badge to the right states 'TODAY ONLY'.
